item.description:

item.title: Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse offers 165 years of history with ocean views from 105-step climb
item.description: The Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse, built in 1860, has guided ships along Florida's Atlantic coast for more than 165 years and offers panoramic views from its 105-step spiral staircase.

item.title: TCCEED places 61 Treasure Coast students in paid summer internships, applications triple
item.description: TCCEED expanded its paid summer internship program in its second year, doubling employer participation and placing 61 students in local jobs.

item.title: Port St. Lucie ranks No. 67 most stressed city in U.S., 42nd for financial stress
item.description: Port St. Lucie was ranked as the No. 67 most stressed city in the United States according to a new WalletHub study released this month.

item.title: Port St. Lucie soccer stadium groundbreaking set for November, new renderings released
item.description: Port St. Lucie SC released new renderings of its 6,000-seat stadium at the Walton & One development on U.S. 1 and Walton Road, with groundbreaking planned for November.

item.title: Karolina Muchova Ends Coco Gauff's Wimbledon Run in Dramatic Tiebreaker
item.description: Karolina Muchova ended Coco Gauff's run at Wimbledon with a 6-2, 1-6, 7-6 (10) victory Thursday that ended with a drama-filled tiebreaker.

item.title: Czech Player Linda Noskova Wins Wimbledon After Blowing Five Match Points
item.description: Linda Noskova recovered from a second-set meltdown in which she wasted five match points to win Wimbledon on Saturday, defeating Karolina Muchova in an all-Czech final.

item.title: Justin Bieber, Madonna to Join World Cup Final Halftime Show
item.description: Justin Bieber will join Madonna, Shakira and BTS in a star-studded, Super Bowl-style halftime show at the World Cup final, FIFA announced Wednesday.

item.title: Florida Homeowner Faces Uninsured Hurricane Milton Damage Two Months After Paying Off House
item.description: A Florida resident who recently paid off his mortgage saw Hurricane Milton tear the roof from his home, leaving him to cover repair costs without insurance protection.
